stimuli.description: 36 sets of three-dimensional physical objects, each set comprising one standard object and three comparison objects. Objects varied in material, shape, size, texture, hardness, temperature, weight, and functional properties.

limitations: Execution of one EP may inevitably involve another to some degree, potentially inflating the effectiveness of nonpredicted EPs.

The particular instructions given may have reduced the effectiveness of an EP by constraining its execution (e.g., enclosure designed to eliminate unsupported holding, potentially underestimating performance for global shape/volume).
The intersubject reliability scores obtained were likely lower than what would occur in future studies due to scoring rules still under development.
